assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness that are concerning for potential arrhythmia in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with cardiac rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period.
The service is supported by diagnoses I34.0 and R42.
The clinical indication directly demonstrates medical necessity for the mobile cardiac telemetry service.
